description: ML components, chart components, page-level changes: ProbabilityHistogram label fix, Home page enrichment, per-route subtitle updates, ConfusionMatrix polish, FeatureImportance accessibility improvement, PredictionCard improvements, and token cleanup across all page files. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens) and FEAT-002 (UI primitives). All pages already wire up correctly — only targeted edits.
steps:
1. src/components/charts/ProbabilityHistogram.tsx — LABEL FIX (highest priority):
   The histogram XAxis currently uses bins like '0.0–0.1'. The ReferenceLine x prop tries to match the bin label of the threshold bucket, which is fragile and currently does not show correctly. Fix:
   a) Add a proper axis label to XAxis: <XAxis ... label={{ value: 'Hybrid Score (calibrated)', fill: CHART_COLORS.text, fontSize: 10, position: 'insideBottom', offset: -5 }} />. Increase BarChart bottom margin from 0 to 20 to accommodate label.
   b) The ReferenceLine: keep as-is but add a second label prop attribute: position:'insideTopRight' so it never overlaps the bars.
   c) Add a YAxis label: <YAxis ... label={{ value: 'Row Count', fill: CHART_COLORS.text, fontSize: 10, angle: -90, position: 'insideLeft', offset: 10 }} />.
   d) Increase legend font size in wrapperStyle from 12 to 11 (makes room).
   e) No changes to data generation logic or threshold prop.

2. src/components/ml/ConfusionMatrix.tsx — VISUAL POLISH:
   - Header text: change text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 to text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest, color via style={{color:'var(--text-secondary)'}}.
   - FP cell: currently has very faint text (text-red-400/60). Increase to text-red-400/80 so it is more readable.
   - FN cell: similarly change text-amber-400/60 to text-amber-400/80.
   - Summary bar bottom: replace hardcoded border-[#1e3a5f] with border-[var(--border)].
   - Overall container: replace border-[#1e3a5f] bg-[#0a1628] with border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)].

3. src/components/ml/FeatureImportance.tsx — ACCESSIBILITY + POLISH:
   - Container: replace border-[#1e3a5f] bg-[#0a1628] with var(--border)/var(--bg-card) tokens.
   - Feature name width: change w-48 to w-44 (slightly narrower) to give more room to the bar on small screens.
   - Bar track: replace bg-[#1e3a5f] with bg-[var(--border)] so it uses the token.
   - Add title attribute to each feature name span for accessibility: title={item.feature}.
   - Footer note: replace border-[#1e3a5f] with border-[var(--border)].

4. src/components/ml/PredictionCard.tsx — TOKEN CLEANUP:
   - Replace all hardcoded border-[#1e3a5f] with border-[var(--border)].
   - Replace bg-[#0a1628] with bg-[var(--bg-card)].
   - Attack rate bar track: replace bg-[#1e3a5f] with bg-[var(--border)].
   - All other logic (KPI grid, hybrid config, detection rate) unchanged.

5. src/components/ml/ModelCard.tsx — TOKEN CLEANUP:
   - Replace bg-[#0a1628] with bg-[var(--bg-card)], border-[#1e3a5f] with border-[var(--border)].
   - All metric/KPI logic unchanged.

6. src/components/ml/FileUpload.tsx — TOKEN CLEANUP:
   - Replace bg-[#0a1628] / border-[#1e3a5f] in the idle state fallback style objects with var(--bg-card)/var(--border).
   - No logic changes.

7. src/app/home/page.tsx — CONTENT ENRICHMENT:
   This page has no DashboardLayout and no Navbar — it is the standalone landing page. Specific changes only:
   a) Header section: the existing h1 is correct. Change the badge from 'MCA Research Project' to 'SOC Alert Triage · Hybrid ML Research'.
   b) Add a new fourth section after 'Triage Levels' and before 'Explore the Dashboard' titled 'Key Results at a Glance'. This section shows 4 metric highlight chips in a 2×2 grid:
      Row 1: 'Secondary Hybrid F1 — 99.65%' (violet), 'Primary Hybrid Accuracy — 97.59%' (blue)
      Row 2: 'Fewest Missed Attacks — 20 FN (Secondary)' (emerald), 'Best AUC — 99.95% (Secondary RF)' (amber)
      Each chip is a small rounded card using existing WorkflowStep-like styling (bg-panel, border-color, text-primary).
   c) Technology stack section: add 'FastAPI' and 'Isotonic Calibration' to the tech badges list.
   d) The NavButton component's primary style currently uses --accent (cyan). Change primary button to use a blue-to-violet gradient matching the brand: background:'linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#8B5CF6)', color:'#fff', borderColor:'transparent'.
   e) All existing sections (Approach, Experiments, Triage Levels, Navigation) remain structurally unchanged.

8. src/app/overview/page.tsx — SUBTITLE + TOKEN CLEANUP:
   - DashboardLayout subtitle: change 'Unified view of both intrusion-detection models' to 'Real-time SOC metrics across both experiments'.
   - PageHeader subtitle: change 'CIC-IDS-2017 · Suricata Testbed · Confidence-Based Hybrid ML Framework' to 'Confidence-Based Hybrid ML Framework · Dual-dataset evaluation results'.
   - Key Findings section: replace hardcoded bg-[#0a1628] / bg-[#0f1f3d] / border-[#1e3a5f] with var(--bg-card) / var(--surface-raised) / var(--border) tokens.
   - Model performance cards (Primary/Secondary): replace hardcoded bg-[#0a1628] border-blue-500/20 with bg-[var(--bg-card)] (border-blue-500/20 is intentional branding, keep).

9. src/app/primary-model/page.tsx — SUBTITLE + TOKEN CLEANUP:

   - PageHeader subtitle: change 'Suricata-based intrusion detection on testbed network traffic' to 'LR + RF hybrid on 22 Suricata features · w_LR=0.30 · w_RF=0.70 · threshold=0.5025'.
   - Upload section container: replace border-[#1e3a5f] bg-[#0a1628] with var(--border)/var(--bg-card).

13. src/app/analysis/page.tsx — TOKEN CLEANUP ONLY (NO id field changes):
    - Replace border-[#1e3a5f] / bg-[#0a1628] / bg-[#0f1f3d] in the attack signatures grid with var() tokens.
    - IMPORTANT: The STATS_COLUMNS definition uses two columns with key='attack_median'; the second one has id='attack_normal_ratio'. This id field MUST NOT be removed or renamed — it is the React key override for the duplicate key. Do not touch STATS_COLUMNS at all.

    - DashboardLayout subtitle: change 'Full evaluation metrics across all models and datasets' to 'Comprehensive test-set evaluation — all 6 models × 2 datasets'.
    - PageHeader subtitle: change 'Comprehensive evaluation on unseen test sets — no data leakage' to 'All metrics on held-out test data · Primary (3,607 rows) · Secondary (30,000 rows)'.
    - FN analysis section: replace hardcoded bg-[#0f1f3d] border-[#1e3a5f] with var() tokens.

15. src/app/results/page.tsx — SUBTITLE + TOKEN CLEANUP:
    - DashboardLayout subtitle: change 'Sample prediction results from secondary model test set' to 'Row-level hybrid scores, risk classification, and triage levels'.
    - PageHeader subtitle: change 'Detailed row-level results showing LR, RF, Hybrid Score, and risk classification' to 'LR + RF calibrated probabilities → Hybrid Score → Attack/Normal decision → SOC triage level'.
    - Quick stats mini-cards: replace border-[#1e3a5f] bg-[#0a1628] with var() tokens.
    - Score interpretation guide cards: replace bg-[#0f1f3d] with bg-[var(--surface-raised)].

16. src/app/configuration/page.tsx — SUBTITLE + TOKEN CLEANUP:
    - DashboardLayout subtitle: change 'Experiment parameters, model config, and system information' to 'All experiment parameters confirmed from training artifacts — read-only'.
    - Section inner div: the Section component uses hardcoded border-[#1e3a5f] bg-[#0a1628] bg-[#0f1f3d] — replace with var() tokens inside the Section component definition within this file.
    - KV row border: replace border-[#1e3a5f]/40 with border-[var(--border)]/40.
    - Feature tag pills: replace bg-blue-500/10 border-blue-500/15 (already token-like) — leave as-is (intentional branding).
